item.title: Circleville restaurants cited for health violations
item.description: CIRCLEVILLE, Ohio — Two Circleville eateries were cited for health and safety violations during recent inspections by the Pickaway County Health Department. item.description: PIKE COUNTY, Ohio — The death penalty is again an option for prosecutors in the upcoming trial of Billy Wagner, the final remaining defendant in the 2016 Pike County massacre, following a ruling by the 4th District Court of Appeals.
